note: Retailers the shopping page can open a search at. `search` takes the URL-encoded term in place of {q}. `checked` records how the pattern was verified on 2026-11-14: "ok" means two different terms (BME280, INMP441) gave different, relevant results; "blocked" is the store's standard search URL but the store refuses automated requests, so it was not opened; "broken" means the pattern is known not to work and the shopping page does not offer it. `query: "model"` means the shop matches every word and has Norwegian or Swedish product titles, so a long English search term finds nothing: the page then searches only for the model number (BME280, INMP441) when the term has one. `note` says how the results load. Regions are ISO country codes plus EU, UK, US and ALL. Add a store by adding an entry; nothing else needs to change.
